SaNoor is the enabler of high brightness lighting and high speed wireless communication.

SaNoor is a group of scientists, engineers and innovators with 10+ years experience in optoelectronics and photonics. They understand technology and they know how to utilize the state-of-the-art technology to solve the challenges you are facing.
